# Shailesh Kushwaha

### Ph.D. Research Scholar

Department of Mechanical Engineering  
**Indian Institute of Technology Madras**

My research lies at the intersection of **experimental heat transfer, computational fluid dynamics, reduced-order modeling, and scientific machine learning**, with applications in thermal management of electronic systems and data centers.

## Research Highlights

### Experimental Thermal Engineering

Design and development of experimental facilities for electronics and data center cooling, with experimental investigations of advanced thermal management systems.

### Computational Thermal Engineering

Development and validation of CFD models for analyzing airflow and temperature distributions in thermal management systems.

### Scientific Machine Learning

Development of machine-learning-assisted reduced-order models and exploration of physics-informed approaches for accelerating thermal simulations.
